story.heading: From Passion to Performance

Over the years, we grew from a web design studio to a full-service conversion lab. We invested in people, technology, and processes that allow us to consistently deliver measurable conversions at the highest level of quality.

Today, with expertise in web development, digital advertising, artificial intelligence, and media production — we offer integrated conversion systems covering the entire digital spectrum. Every project is an opportunity to prove that excellence in digital marketing means measurable conversions.

items.question: How much does Facebook and Instagram advertising cost?
items.answer: The minimum recommended budget for Facebook Ads is 300 EUR/month, plus management fee. Cost per lead varies by industry: from 2-5 EUR for B2C to 10-30 EUR for B2B. Contact us for a personalized estimate based on your goals.

items.question: How does Facebook Pixel work and why is it important?
items.answer: Facebook Pixel is a tracking code installed on your website that monitors visitor actions. It is essential for campaign optimization, custom audience creation and remarketing. We also configure Conversions API for precise tracking even with current privacy restrictions.

items.question: What types of audiences do you target?
items.answer: We use core audiences (demographics, interests, behaviors), custom audiences (website visitors, email lists, page interactions) and lookalike audiences (people similar to your existing customers). This combination ensures maximum reach with high relevance.

items.question: Facebook Ads or Instagram Ads — which is better?
items.answer: It depends on your goals and audience. Instagram excels for visual brands and 18-35 audiences, while Facebook offers more detailed targeting and better performance for B2B lead generation. We recommend a cross-platform strategy using both for optimal results, combined with Google Ads campaigns for complete coverage.

items.question: What ad formats do you use?
items.answer: We use all available formats: static images, carousels, video, Reels, Stories and collections. We choose the optimal format based on campaign objective and A/B test to identify what works best for your specific audience.

items.question: How long until I see results?
items.answer: First results appear within 1-2 weeks of launch. Optimal performance is reached after 4-6 weeks of continuous optimization, as Meta's algorithm learns and we accumulate enough data for informed decisions.

items.question: How do you measure campaign success?
items.answer: We track clear KPIs: cost per lead, cost per conversion, ROAS, reach, frequency and click-through rate. You receive detailed monthly reports with performance analysis and optimization recommendations. We combine Facebook Ads data with Google Ads for a complete cross-platform view.

items.question: How much does TikTok advertising cost?
items.answer: The minimum recommended budget for TikTok Ads is 300 EUR/month, plus management fee. TikTok has lower cost per view than other platforms, with CPMs starting from 2-5 EUR. Final cost depends on objectives, audience and chosen campaign type.

items.question: What type of content works on TikTok?
items.answer: Authentic, native content performs best. Vertical videos of 15-60 seconds with a strong hook in the first 3 seconds, trend sounds and natural storytelling generate the best results. We avoid classic ads — on TikTok, content needs to feel organic.

items.question: Are TikTok Ads right for my business?
items.answer: TikTok is ideal if your target audience is 18-45 years old. It works excellently for e-commerce, beauty, food, fitness, fashion and entertainment. However, even B2B brands find success on TikTok through educational content and creative thought leadership.

items.question: What TikTok ad formats are available?
items.answer: The main formats are: In-Feed Ads (feed ads), TopView (full-screen on app open), Spark Ads (amplifying organic posts), Brand Effects (AR filters) and TikTok Shopping (integrated commerce). Each format has specific advantages depending on campaign objective.

items.question: How long until I see results on TikTok?
items.answer: Initial results appear within the first 1-2 weeks. Full optimization takes 3-4 weeks as TikTok's algorithm learns and we identify the creative and audience combinations that perform best.

items.question: TikTok Ads vs Instagram Reels — which is better?
items.answer: TikTok excels at organic reach and engagement with younger audiences (18-30), while Instagram Reels benefits from Meta's ecosystem and advanced targeting. We recommend a multi-platform strategy that includes both, alongside Google Ads campaigns for complete coverage.

items.question: How much do SEO services cost?
items.answer: SEO service prices start from 500 EUR/month for basic packages that include on-page optimization and monitoring. Complete packages with technical audit, content strategy and link building start from 1,000 EUR/month. The exact cost depends on industry competitiveness, website size and your goals. Contact us for a free evaluation.

items.question: How long does it take to see SEO results?
items.answer: SEO is a long-term investment. First ranking improvements are typically observed in 3-4 months, while significant results — consistent organic traffic growth and conversions — appear after 6-12 months of continuous optimization. This varies depending on keyword competitiveness and your website's current state.

items.question: What does an SEO audit include?
items.answer: A complete SEO audit includes: technical analysis (speed, Core Web Vitals, indexing, mobile-friendliness), on-page audit (titles, meta, headings, content, internal links), off-page audit (backlink profile, domain authority), competition analysis and keyword research. We deliver a detailed report with prioritized issues and an action plan.

items.question: What is the difference between On-Page and Off-Page SEO?
items.answer: On-Page SEO refers to optimizations made directly on your website: content, titles, meta descriptions, headings, images, internal links and URL structure. Off-Page SEO refers to actions outside your website that build authority: link building, guest posting, digital PR and mentions in relevant publications. Both are essential for ranking.

items.question: Do you offer Local SEO?
items.answer: Yes, we offer complete Local SEO services. We optimize Google Business Profile, manage online reviews, build consistent NAP (Name, Address, Phone) citations in relevant directories and implement LocalBusiness schema markup. Local SEO is essential for businesses serving customers in a specific geographic area — combined with local Google Ads campaigns, we ensure complete visibility.

items.question: How do you measure SEO results?
items.answer: We track clear metrics: target keyword rankings, organic traffic (Google Analytics + Search Console), click-through rate (CTR), conversions from organic traffic, Core Web Vitals and domain authority. Monthly reports include performance analysis, month-over-month comparisons and optimization recommendations. You also have access to a real-time dashboard.

items.question: Why choose Conversion Lab for SEO?
items.answer: We combine technical SEO expertise with deep understanding of businesses in Romania. We have over 100 successfully completed SEO projects, a 95% retention rate and a dedicated team that constantly follows the latest Google algorithm updates. Additionally, we integrate SEO services with Google Ads and Facebook Ads campaigns for a complete and coherent digital strategy.

hero.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.description: Answers to the most important questions about our digital conversion systems, collaboration process and the Conversion Lab team.

items.question: What is Conversion Lab?
items.answer: Conversion Lab is a conversion lab based in Bucharest, Romania. We provide comprehensive online conversion systems: web development, paid advertising, artificial intelligence in marketing and media content. Our team combines technical expertise with creativity to deliver measurable conversions.

items.question: What services do you offer?
items.answer: We offer a full range of digital marketing services: Google Ads, Facebook and Instagram Ads, TikTok Ads, SEO (search engine optimization), email marketing and marketing consultancy. Each service can be contracted individually or as part of an integrated strategy. Visit our services page for full details on each solution.

items.question: Where do you operate?
items.answer: Our headquarters are in Bucharest, at Bulevardul Aviatorilor 106, but we work with clients across Romania and internationally. Most collaborations are conducted online, allowing us to deliver the same quality of services regardless of the client's location. We schedule in-person or video meetings based on your preferences.

items.question: What is the experience of the Conversion Lab team?
items.answer: Our team consists of specialists with experience in digital marketing, paid advertising, SEO, web development and content strategy. Each team member is certified on the platforms they work with (Google Ads, Meta, TikTok) and constantly participates in training programs to stay up to date with the latest industry trends.

items.question: How does a collaboration with Conversion Lab begin?
items.answer: The process starts with a free consultation where we analyze your business needs and objectives. Fill out the contact form or schedule an online meeting, and our team will get back to you with a personalized proposal within 48 hours. After accepting the proposal, we establish the strategy, KPIs and begin implementation.

items.question: How long does a typical project take?
items.answer: Duration varies depending on complexity. A Google Ads or Facebook Ads campaign can be operational within 5-7 business days. An SEO project typically needs 3-6 months for visible results. Website development takes between 4 and 12 weeks. At the start of each collaboration, we set a clear timeline with milestones and deadlines.

items.question: How do we communicate during the project?
items.answer: Communication is a priority for us. Each client receives a dedicated account manager, available via email, phone and WhatsApp. We organize weekly or bi-weekly status meetings, and all materials and reports are accessible in a shared workspace. We respond to any request within 24 hours.

items.question: Do you provide performance reports?
items.answer: Yes, transparency is one of our core principles. We provide detailed monthly reports with relevant metrics: traffic, conversions, cost per acquisition, ROI and other KPIs established at the start of the collaboration. Reports include results analysis, optimization recommendations and the action plan for the following month.

items.question: How much do Conversion Lab services cost?
items.answer: Prices vary depending on the service, complexity and advertising budget. We offer customized packages for each client, starting from the specific needs and goals of the business. Contact us for a free, no-obligation quote — our team will prepare a proposal tailored to your budget.

items.question: Are there long-term contracts?
items.answer: We offer contractual flexibility. For advertising and SEO services, we recommend a minimum commitment of 3 months to allow for optimization and achieving significant results. For web development projects, the contract covers the project duration. We have no penalizing termination clauses — we want clients to stay because of results, not contractual obligations.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept bank transfers, credit cards and invoice payments. Billing is done monthly, with a standard payment term of 14 days from invoice date. For larger projects, we offer installment payment options, with an advance payment at the start of the collaboration.

items.question: Do you offer guarantees for results?
items.answer: In digital marketing, results depend on many factors, including the market, competition and allocated budget. We don't promise guaranteed results, but we commit to applying best practices and constantly optimizing campaigns for maximum performance. The transparency of our reports allows you to see exactly what results we achieve and what actions we take.

items.question: How can I contact you?
items.answer: You can reach us through multiple channels: fill out the form on the contact page, send an email to cretualin@aceagency.ro, call +40 750 465 757 or schedule an online meeting directly on our website. Our Bucharest office is open Monday to Friday, from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

items.question: How quickly do you respond to inquiries?
items.answer: We aim to respond to all inquiries within 24 business hours. For urgent matters, we recommend contacting us by phone. Existing clients have priority access through their dedicated account manager, who is available during business hours for any questions or needs.

items.question: Do you offer free consultations?
items.answer: Yes, the first consultation is always free and without obligation. During this session, we discuss your business objectives, analyze your current online presence and identify growth opportunities. Schedule a consultation through the contact page or through the meeting calendar available on our website.

meta.title: Privacy Policy - Conversion Lab
meta.description: Conversion Lab Privacy Policy. Learn how we collect, use and protect your personal data in compliance with GDPR.

sections.heading: 1. Introduction
sections.content:
Conversion Lab, located at Bulevardul Aviatorilor 106, Bucharest, Romania, is committed to protecting the privacy of your personal data. This policy describes how we collect, use, store and protect your personal information.

This policy applies to all visitors of the aceagency.ro website and all individuals who interact with our services. Please read this document carefully to understand our practices regarding personal data.

sections.heading: 2. Personal Data Collected
sections.content:
We collect the following categories of personal data:

Data provided directly by you: full name, email address, phone number, message submitted through the contact form, email address for newsletter subscription.

Data collected automatically: IP address, browser and device type, pages visited, visit duration, traffic source. This data is collected through cookies and similar technologies (see our Cookie Policy for details).

sections.heading: 3. Purpose of Data Processing
sections.content:
We process your personal data for the following purposes:

Responding to requests submitted through the contact form and scheduling consultations.

Sending the newsletter with digital marketing information, case studies and agency news (only with your explicit consent).

Analyzing website traffic to improve user experience and website performance.

Fulfilling legal and contractual obligations.

sections.heading: 4. Legal Basis for Processing
sections.content:
We process your data based on the following legal grounds, in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Article 6:

Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)): for sending the newsletter and using marketing and analytics cookies.

Legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)): for traffic analysis, service improvement and communication regarding your requests.

Performance of a contract or pre-contractual measures (Art. 6(1)(b)): for processing quote requests and providing requested services.

sections.heading: 5. Data Sharing with Third Parties
sections.content:
We do not sell your personal data to third parties. We may share data with the following categories of service providers:

Hosting and infrastructure providers (Vercel) for website operation.

Email service providers (Resend) for sending messages and newsletters.

Google Analytics for website traffic analysis.

Cal.com for scheduling consultations.

All our providers comply with GDPR standards and have signed Data Processing Agreements (DPA).

sections.heading: 6. Your Rights
sections.content:
Under GDPR (Articles 15-22), you have the following rights:

Right of access (Art. 15): you can request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.

Right to rectification (Art. 16): you can request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.

Right to erasure (Art. 17): you can request deletion of personal data in certain circumstances.

Right to data portability (Art. 20): you can request the transfer of your data to another controller.

Right to object (Art. 21): you can object to data processing for direct marketing purposes.

Right to withdraw consent: you can withdraw your consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of prior processing.

To exercise any right, contact us at cretualin@aceagency.ro. We will respond within 30 days.

sections.heading: 7. Cookies
sections.content: Our website uses cookies for functionality, analytics and marketing purposes. For detailed information about the types of cookies used and how to manage them, please see our Cookie Policy.

sections.heading: 8. Data Security
sections.content:
We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, loss, destruction or alteration. These measures include data encryption in transit (HTTPS/TLS), access control to our systems and periodic review of security practices.

However, no electronic transmission or storage system is 100% secure. In the event of a data security breach, we will notify the relevant authorities and affected individuals in accordance with legal requirements.

sections.heading: 9. Retention Period
sections.content:
We store your personal data only for the period necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected:

Contact form data: 2 years from the last interaction.

Newsletter data: until unsubscription.

Analytics data: 26 months (as per Google Analytics settings).

After the retention period expires, data is deleted or anonymized.

sections.heading: 10. Policy Changes
sections.content:
We reserve the right to update this privacy policy periodically. Any significant changes will be communicated by publishing the updated version on this page, with the date of the last update indicated.

We recommend checking this page periodically to stay informed about any changes.

sections.heading: 11. Contact
sections.content:
For any questions or requests related to personal data protection, you can contact us at:

Conversion Lab
Bulevardul Aviatorilor 106, Bucharest, Romania
Email: cretualin@aceagency.ro
Phone: 0750 465 757

You also have the right to file a complaint with the National Supervisory Authority for Personal Data Processing (ANSPDCP) — www.dataprotection.ro.

meta.title: Cookie Policy - Conversion Lab
meta.description: Conversion Lab Cookie Policy. Learn what cookies we use, why and how you can manage them. GDPR and ePrivacy Directive compliant.

sections.heading: 1. What Are Cookies
sections.content:
Cookies are small text files stored on your device (computer, phone, tablet) when you visit a website. They allow the site to remember information about your visit, such as language preferences or other settings, making navigation easier and future visits more efficient.

Cookies do not contain directly identifiable personal information and cannot access other data on your device.

sections.heading: 2. Cookies Used on aceagency.ro
sections.content:
We use the following categories of cookies:

Necessary Cookies: Essential for the website to function. Include session cookies, consent preferences and security. Cannot be disabled. Duration: session or up to 1 year.

Analytics Cookies: Help us understand how visitors navigate the site by collecting anonymous data (pages visited, visit duration, traffic source). Provider: Google Analytics. Duration: up to 26 months.

Marketing Cookies: Allow display of relevant ads on other platforms. Providers: Google Ads, Facebook Pixel. Duration: up to 2 years.

Functional Cookies: Enable additional features such as Google Maps integration, Cal.com scheduling widget and content personalization. Duration: session or up to 1 year.

sections.heading: 3. Third-Party Cookies
sections.content:
In addition to our own cookies, our website may load cookies from third parties:

Google Analytics (analytics.google.com): Collects anonymous data about website traffic. Cookies: _ga, _ga_*, _gid. Privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Google Maps (maps.google.com): Enables the interactive map on the contact page. Requires acceptance of functional cookies.

Cal.com (cal.com): Meeting scheduling widget. May set its own session cookies. Privacy policy: https://cal.com/privacy

sections.heading: 4. Managing Cookies
sections.content:
You can manage your cookie preferences in two ways:

Consent Banner: On your first visit to the site, a cookie banner will appear allowing you to accept or reject each category of cookies (analytics, marketing, functional). You can change your preferences at any time by accessing the cookie settings in the website footer.

Browser Settings: Most browsers allow you to control cookies through their settings. You can block all cookies or only third-party cookies. Note that blocking certain cookies may affect website functionality.

Chrome: Settings > Privacy and security > Cookies
Firefox: Settings > Privacy & Security > Cookies
Safari: Preferences > Privacy > Cookies
Edge: Settings > Cookies and site permissions

sections.heading: 5. Storage Duration
sections.content:
Necessary cookies: session (deleted when browser closes) or up to 1 year for consent preferences.

Analytics cookies (_ga): 2 years from last interaction. _gid: 24 hours.

Marketing cookies: up to 2 years, depending on provider.

Functional cookies: session or up to 1 year.

sections.heading: 6. Cookie Policy Changes
sections.content:
We reserve the right to update this cookie policy periodically, especially when adding new features or integrating new services. The date of the last update is displayed at the top of this page.

Significant changes will be communicated through the cookie banner, which will request your consent again.

sections.heading: 7. Contact
sections.content:
For questions about the use of cookies on our website, you can contact us at:

Conversion Lab

guarantee.heading: 100% Money-Back Guarantee
guarantee.description: If you don't see measurable results in the first 30 days, we'll refund your investment. No questions asked.
guarantee.reinforcement: We've worked with over 50 online stores. We know what works.

0.question: How much does ACE Growth Engine cost?
0.answer: The investment depends on your store's complexity and active channels. We work with a fixed monthly fee that includes all services — no hidden costs. During the free audit, we provide a personalized estimate based on your growth goals and available ads budget.

1.question: How soon will I see results?
1.answer: Most clients see measurable improvements within the first 30 days. Results depend on your starting point — if you already have traffic and a validated product, we can accelerate significantly. If starting from zero, the first 60-90 days are for building and testing, with accelerated growth after.

2.question: Do you only work with online stores?
2.answer: ACE Growth Engine is optimized for online stores (e-commerce). If you have a services business or SaaS, we can discuss during the audit whether the system fits your needs or if we recommend a different approach.

3.question: What if I'm not happy with the results?
3.answer: We don't have mandatory long-term contracts. We work based on performance and total transparency. If after 90 days you don't see measurable growth, you can stop the collaboration without penalties. In practice, our retention rate is over 85% precisely because results speak for themselves.

4.question: What is AdPilot AI? How does it help me?
4.answer: AdPilot is our proprietary AI-based monitoring system. It analyzes ad accounts 24/7 and alerts you when it detects anomalies: costs rising suddenly, audience exhaustion, creatives fatiguing. It prevents budget losses before you notice them.

5.question: Do I need a large ads budget?
5.answer: Not necessarily. We work with budgets starting from 1,000 EUR/month on ads. What matters is having a validated product and a functional store. During the audit, we recommend the optimal budget for your goals and how to scale it progressively as results grow.

6.question: How is ACE Growth Engine different from a classic PPC agency?
6.answer: A classic agency manages one channel (usually Google or Facebook) and reports monthly. ACE Growth Engine is an integrated system: we manage all paid channels, create creatives in-house, optimize your site's CRO, automate email marketing and monitor everything with AI. It's the difference between hiring a driver and having a Formula 1 team.
